concerns.text: Tasks T031-T041 (Blind Agent, Forgetting, Noise, Consolidation, Scaling Limit) and T042 introduce mechanisms and metrics entirely absent from spec.md (FR-001 to FR-012) and plan.md. These tasks have no corresponding FR/SC to satisfy, creating unapproved scope creep that prevents verification against the spec.

Tasks T011, T011b, T018, T022, and T027 contain unresolved `{{claim:...}}` placeholders and `<!-- FAILED: unspecified -->` markers. These tasks lack concrete implementation steps (e.g., specific game counts, token limits) required to satisfy FR-001, FR-008, and US-3 acceptance criteria.

Task T030 is marked as failed/rejected in the text ('No scaling_plot.pdf file is present') yet remains a pending task without a re-planned sub-step to generate the artifact required by SC-005 and US-3.
Tasks T002 and T004b contain unresolved `{{claim:...}}` placeholders, indicating missing configuration values or dataset counts required to satisfy FR-011 and the plan's dataset constraints.

Tasks T039 ('Consolidation Cost') and T041 ('Scaling Limit' check) define new metrics/flags with no corresponding Success Criteria (SC-*) or Functional Requirement (FR-*) in spec.md, making their verification criteria undefined.
